name: local-clean-link
title: Clean Link
description: Remove common tracking parameters from links locally, with a preview before copying.
author: bensonlu

preferences.name: additionalParameters
preferences.title: Additional Parameters to Remove
preferences.description: Comma-separated names or prefixes ending in *. Example: campaign_id, track_*. Applies to every website. Enter names only, without ? or values. Reopen Clean Link after changing settings.

preferences.name: keepParameters
preferences.title: Parameters to Always Keep
preferences.description: Comma-separated names or prefixes ending in *. Overrides both built-in and additional removal rules on every website. Reopen Clean Link after changing settings.

preferences.name: useClipboardOnLaunch
preferences.title: Start with Clipboard
preferences.description: Load the current clipboard when it contains a complete HTTP or HTTPS URL. Nothing is copied or pasted until you choose an action.
preferences.label: Preview the link from my clipboard on launch

commands.name: clean-link
commands.title: Clean Link
commands.description: Paste a link, preview removed trackers, and copy the cleaned URL.
